parameters.query:
WITH freed AS (
    SELECT sc.flight_id, sc.class
    FROM seat_classes sc
    JOIN flights f ON f.id = sc.flight_id
    WHERE sc.available_seats > 0
      AND f.status = 'scheduled'
      AND f.departure_ts > now()
),
candidate AS (
    SELECT w.id
    FROM waitlist w
    JOIN freed fr ON fr.flight_id = w.flight_id AND fr.class = w.seat_class
    WHERE w.status = 'waiting'
    ORDER BY w.joined_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE waitlist w
SET status = 'offered',
    offered_at = now(),
    offer_expires_at = now() + interval '6 hours'
FROM candidate c, passengers p
WHERE w.id = c.id AND p.id = w.passenger_id
RETURNING w.id AS waitlist_id, w.flight_id, w.passenger_id, w.seat_class,
          w.offer_expires_at, p.email, p.full_name;

parameters.subject: =Seat available on flight {{ $json.flight_id }} — claim within 6 hours!
parameters.message:
=Hello {{ $json.full_name }},

You have until {{ $json.offer_expires_at }} to claim this seat. If unclaimed by then, it will be offered to the next passenger on the waitlist.

Thank you,
Your Airline
